description: Four-condition experiment comparing retrieval paths for analyzer-assisted architecture generation. Measures how different context sources affect question-answering quality against the consumer benchmark corpus.

conditions.name: Baseline Context
conditions.description: Agent reads only the existing architecture documentation tree (GENERATED_ARCHITECTURE.md, PLATFORM.md, README.md, component .md files). No index, no query tool. This is the control condition matching the current v1 consumer benchmark setup.

artifact_identity.description: On-disk architecture documentation at a pinned git SHA.

conditions.access_boundary: Agent may only read files under the architecture tree root. No external sources, no query tools, no index files.

conditions.name: Generated INDEX.md Context
conditions.description: Agent reads architecture documentation plus a generated INDEX.md that maps common questions to component sections, provides aliases for renamed components, and summarizes cross-component relationships.
conditions.unavailable_reason: INDEX.md generation is not yet implemented. Requires Phase 2 of the analyzer-assisted agent architecture plan (context index, overlays, and correction feedback).

artifact_identity.description: On-disk architecture documentation plus a generated INDEX.md, both at pinned revisions.

conditions.access_boundary: Agent may read architecture tree and INDEX.md. No query tools, no external sources.

conditions.name: arch-query CLI Context
conditions.description: Agent reads architecture documentation and may issue arch-query CLI queries (callers-of, consumers-of, config-sources, crds, dependency-status, diff) for structured fact retrieval.
conditions.unavailable_reason: arch-query query subcommands are not yet implemented. Requires Phase 3 of the analyzer-assisted agent architecture plan (query interface).

artifact_identity.description: On-disk architecture documentation plus arch-query CLI at a pinned binary version.

conditions.access_boundary: Agent may read architecture tree and issue arch-query queries. Query output is evidence, not authority. No direct source file access.

conditions.name: Combined INDEX.md + arch-query Context
conditions.description: Agent reads architecture documentation, INDEX.md, and may issue arch-query queries. This is the full context condition combining structured indexing with on-demand query retrieval.
conditions.unavailable_reason: Requires both INDEX.md generation (Phase 2) and arch-query query interface (Phase 3) of the analyzer-assisted agent architecture plan.

artifact_identity.description: On-disk architecture documentation, generated INDEX.md, and arch-query CLI, all at pinned revisions.

conditions.access_boundary: Agent may read architecture tree, INDEX.md, and issue arch-query queries. No direct source file access, no external sources.

failure_classifications.description: The architecture documentation contains outdated information that led to an incorrect answer. The correct information exists in source but has not been regenerated.
The architecture documentation does not contain the information needed to answer the question. The information exists in source but was never extracted.
The information exists in the architecture documentation but the agent failed to locate or use it. Navigation, search strategy, or tool use was insufficient.
The question requires reasoning or synthesis beyond what the available context can support. The agent fabricated an answer or made an unsupported inference.
The agent's answer is substantively correct but scored as incorrect due to a defect in the scoring rubric, ground truth, or acceptable variants.
The evaluation failed due to infrastructure issues: agent session crash, timeout, tool denial, or resource exhaustion.

design_constraints.no_silent_fallback: If a condition's artifacts are unavailable, the condition must be skipped with an explicit unavailable status. It must not silently fall back to baseline.
design_constraints.provenance_required: Every result must record the artifact revision (git SHA, index generation SHA, query binary version) used during evaluation.
design_constraints.v1_compatibility: Results from the baseline condition must be scoreable by the existing consumer-v1/score_results.py pipeline without modification.
design_constraints.no_fabrication: Unavailable conditions must not be evaluated with substitute artifacts. Their results must be recorded as condition_unavailable.
